verdict.rationale: Sidecar is documented as letting you use an iPad as a second Mac display to extend your workspace. It is also explicitly positioned for creative Mac apps with Apple Pencil, naming InDesign, Affinity Photo 2 and ZBrush. Universal Control adds shared keyboard and mouse control across Mac and iPad. Missing for 10: setup and pairing requirements or compatibility details beyond marketing copy, and independent or hands-on corroboration of Sidecar's display quality and latency for creative work.
